metaDescription: Order custom 22 oz infusers for your brand. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Perfect for hydration and brand visibility.
introHtml: Custom 22 oz infusers offer a practical way to keep your team or customers hydrated with fruit-infused water on the go. The 22 oz capacity hits a sweet spot between portability and volume, ideal for office breaks, outdoor events, or gym giveaways. These infusers work with a removable fruit chamber, letting users customize their water with fresh flavors. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or laser engraving for a crisp, lasting impression.
